mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, we are looking at clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. The moon is in its Third Quarter phase and you can spot the International Space Station at 3:35 AM as it rises over Middleton near Verona High School and heads toward Fitchburg, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city is moving ahead with plans to pave the Military Ridge State Trail to improve accessibility, while also celebrating the installation of a new Tai Chi Animal Frolics public art sculpture at Century School Park.
We have a busy schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee both happening today, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market coming up tomorrow.
On August 28, officers were called to the area of Church Avenue and South Marietta Street to address reports of juveniles engaging in ding-dong-ditching.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
